abstract: In 35 consecutive patients who were over 11 years of age, surgical exploration was preformed for unilateral undescended testes. To evaluate the quality of spermatogenesis all testes were biopsied. In two patients with macroscopically normal testes a malignancy was detected, one seminoma and one carcinoma in situ with micro-infiltrative carcinoma. In all patients considerable loss of spermatogenesis could be demonstrated and in all but three patients severe degenerative changes were present. On the basis of this study we would consider orchiectomy rather than orchidopexia in patients with unilateral undescended testes presenting at puberty or later.
abstract_ja: 11歳以上の患者35例に対し、片側停留精巣の外科的探索を実施した。精子形成の質を評価するため、全ての精巣を生検した。肉眼的に正常な精巣を有する2例で悪性腫瘍が検出された。1例はセミノーマ、もう1例は微小浸潤を伴う上皮内癌であった。全例で精子形成の著明な低下が認められ、3例を除く全例で高度な変性変化が認められた。本研究に基づき、思春期以降に発見された片側停留精巣では、精巣固定術ではなく精巣摘除術を考慮すべきであると考える。
